Arnaqueur, L'.name: The Con
Arnaqueur, L'.summary: Fight for the win or throw the fight to make some extra cash in this PSP fighting game.

Durarara!! 3way Standoff - Alley.name: Durarara!! 3way Standoff: Alley
Durarara!! 3way Standoff - Alley.summary: Durarara!! 3way standoff -alley- is the director's cut version of the 2010 PSP game Durarara!! 3way standoff. While the gameplay remains unchanged from the original, 3way standoff -alley- features a "what if" scenario as well as downloadable content. The downloadable content includes cosplay for the characters

Elminage III - Ankoku no Shito to Taiyou.name: Elminage III: Ankoku no Shito to Taiyou no Kyuuden
Elminage III - Ankoku no Shito to Taiyou.summary: High above the sea of clouds, the Sun Palace bathes the world in a purifying light that drives away darkness. When the palace begins to fade and creatures of darkness spread across the land, adventurers are summoned to restore the legendary Stairway of Light and reclaim the palace. Players create a party, explore varied dungeons and overcome challenges affected by changing time and weather.

FIFA 14.name: FIFA 14
FIFA 14.summary:
Experience the excitement and realism of the world’s most popular sport in FIFA 14 for the PSP. With updated teams, authentic stadiums, and improved gameplay mechanics, FIFA 14 delivers a soccer experience that captures the essence of the beautiful game.

Take control of your favorite teams and players from leagues all over the world. Enjoy enhanced ball physics, refined player animations, and smarter AI that make every match feel unique and challenging. Whether you're playing a quick match, diving into a full season, or managing your team to glory in Career Mode, FIFA 14 offers endless hours of engaging soccer action.

FIFA 14 also features multiplayer modes, allowing you to challenge your friends in head-to-head matches via Ad-Hoc. Hone your skills in Skill Games, and show off your style with new dribbling techniques and goal celebrations.

With its stunning visuals, authentic audio, and comprehensive gameplay, FIFA 14 for the PSP is the ultimate portable soccer experience. Lace up your boots, step onto the pitch, and lead your team to victory!

This game only released in North America, in digital format.

Resistance - Retribution.name: Resistance: Retribution
Resistance - Retribution.summary: Set in the weeks after Resistance: Fall of Man, Resistance: Retribution follows the story of former British Marine James Grayson. After a personal tragedy - he is forced to kill his own brother inside a Chimeran conversion center - Grayson goes on a vendetta to destroy every conversion center he can find. Eventually Grayson learns that his efforts have been futile... in Western Europe the Chimera have evolved a new method of converting humans to aliens. The European resistance - the Maquis - enlist Grayson's help, and he joins Cartwright and Parker in Operation Overstrike. The war to retake the European continent has begun.
